title: The Perfect Parish
author: Bram Whitlock
blurb: Ines Eriksen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
